shortcuts.dashboard: Track the month balances and move between months.
shortcuts.transactions: Record income, expenses, and transfers and confirm payments.
shortcuts.accounts: Create and organize your accounts and opening balances.
shortcuts.roles: Review and adjust each role's permissions.
shortcuts.account: Change your name and email and review your access.
shortcuts.changeRequests: Approve or reject changes another administrator requested for your profile.
shortcuts.creditCards: Manage your cards, their billing days, and invoices.
shortcuts.creditCardPurchases: Record card purchases in installments and refunds.
shortcuts.recurrences: Plan recurring income, expenses, and card charges and confirm each occurrence.
shortcuts.budgets: Set monthly spending limits and follow your daily allowance.
shortcuts.investments: Track reserves, goals, and investments with contributions, withdrawals, and valuations.

dashboard.description: Track the month's balances, income, and expenses.

balances.actualHint: Sum of the balances of active accounts.
balances.projectedHint: Expected balance at the end of the month, including what is planned.
balances.availableHint: Projected balance minus what is still due on card invoices.

accounts.title: Balances by account
accounts.empty: You have not added any account yet.

income.title: Income
income.empty: No income recorded for this month.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.empty: No expenses recorded for this month.

expensesByCategory.title: Expenses by category
expensesByCategory.empty: No spending to break down by category.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.hint: Planned transactions up to the end of the month, overdue ones included.
upcoming.empty: Nothing planned up to the end of this month.

budget.title: Budget and spending guidance
budget.neverBlocks: Budgets are guidance only: transactions above a limit are still saved.

guidance.BUDGETHint: Overall limit minus paid and planned expenses of the month.
guidance.BALANCEHint: Available balance, since the month has no overall limit.
guidance.dailyHint: Informational: what is left spread over the remaining days.
guidance.noDaysLeft: No days left in this month.

investments.title: Investments and goals
investments.empty: No active investments, reserves, or goals.

hints.openingBalance: Account balance on the given date. Use a negative amount for an overdrawn balance.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Delete {{name}}? Prefer deactivating accounts that were already used. Deleting cannot be undone.

creditCards.title: Credit cards
creditCards.billingDays: Closes on day {{closingDay}} · due on day {{dueDay}}

hints.billingDays: Purchases made on or after the closing day go to the next invoice. Changing the days only affects future invoices.
hints.installments: Each installment goes to a consecutive invoice. The first one absorbs any cents left over.
hints.purchaseLocked: Only the description, category, and notes can change. To correct the amount, date, card, or installments, delete the purchase and record it again.

delete.title: Delete credit card
delete.description: Delete {{name}}? Cards with purchases cannot be deleted; archive them instead. Deleting cannot be undone.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.empty: This card has no invoices yet.

invoice.title: {{card}} invoice · {{month}}
invoice.creditCarried: A credit of {{amount}} carries over to the next invoice.

pay.title: Pay invoice
pay.hint: The payment leaves the selected account. It is not counted as a new expense: the purchases already are.

cancelPayment.title: Cancel payment
cancelPayment.description: Cancel this payment? The amount returns to the account and to the invoice balance. The payment stays as history.

delete.title: Delete purchase
delete.description: Delete {{description}}? This removes every installment. Deleting cannot be undone.

refund.title: Refund purchase
refund.hint: The refund is credited to the invoice of the refund date, even if an earlier invoice was already paid.

delete.title: Delete refund
delete.description: Delete this refund? Only refunds on open invoices can be deleted.

hints.date: Due or expected date when planned; date of the operation when completed.
hints.completedOn: Leave empty to use the transaction date.
hints.completedLocked: Completed transactions keep their amount, dates, and accounts. To correct them, cancel this transaction and record a new one.
hints.canceledLocked: Canceled transactions are kept as history and cannot be changed.

validation.sameAccount: Choose an account other than the source account.

complete.title: Mark as completed
complete.description: Enter the date {{description}} was actually paid or received. Balances change only after this step.

cancel.title: Cancel transaction
cancel.plannedDescription: Cancel {{description}}? It stays in the history and no longer counts in projections. This cannot be undone.
cancel.completedDescription: Cancel {{description}}? Its effect on the account balances is reversed and it stays in the history. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete transaction
delete.description: Delete {{description}}? Only planned transactions can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

fields.endFromInvoiceMonth: No charge from the invoice of

hints.planned: Occurrences are created as planned up to 12 months ahead and never paid or received on their own. Confirm each one when it actually happens.
hints.startDate: Monthly and yearly occurrences keep this day, or the last day of shorter months.
hints.endDate: Leave empty to repeat until you end it.
hints.cardOnlyExpense: Only expenses can be charged to a credit card.
hints.cardCharges: Each charge joins an invoice only when you confirm it.
hints.editLocked: Changes apply to planned occurrences only; completed and canceled ones are never changed. The type, frequency, dates, and card are fixed: to change them, end this recurrence and create a new one.
hints.endFrom: Planned occurrences on or after this date are removed.
hints.endFromInvoiceMonth: Planned charges on this invoice and later ones are removed. Earlier invoices stay as they are.

validation.endBeforeStart: Choose an end date on or after the start date.

pause.title: Pause recurrence
pause.description: Pause {{description}}? Planned occurrences from today on are removed and none are created while it is paused. Resuming creates occurrences from that day on. Completed history is kept.

end.title: End recurrence
end.history: Completed occurrences always stay in the history, and planned ones before the cut are kept. Ending cannot be undone.

occurrences.title: Occurrences · {{description}}
occurrences.accountHint: Each occurrence is a planned transaction until you confirm it.
occurrences.cardHint: Planned charges show the invoice they are expected on and join it only once confirmed.

confirm.title: Confirm occurrence
confirm.accountDescription: Enter the amount and the date {{description}} was actually paid or received. Balances change only after this step.
confirm.cardDescription: Enter the amount and the purchase date of {{description}}. Confirming adds the charge to the matching invoice.

skip.title: Skip occurrence
skip.description: Skip the occurrence of {{date}}? It stays listed as canceled and the rest of the recurrence is unchanged. This cannot be undone.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set an overall limit and optional category limits for each month.

hints.totalLimit: Optional when you set category limits.

validation.empty: Set an overall limit or at least one category limit.

delete.title: Delete the budget for {{month}}?
delete.content: The limits of this month are removed. Transactions are not changed.

investments.title: Investments
investments.description: Manage investments, reserves, and goals. Contributions and withdrawals move money between an account and the investment without counting as income or expenses.

hints.targetAmount: Optional. Leave empty when there is no target.
hints.state: Planned movements only change balances once confirmed.

hint.CONTRIBUTION: The amount leaves the account and is added to the investment. It does not count as an expense.
hint.WITHDRAWAL: The amount leaves the investment and returns to the account. It does not count as income.

valuation.title: Update value of {{name}}
valuation.hint: Record the current market value. Only the investment changes; no account balance is affected.

delete.title: Delete investment
delete.description: Delete {{name}}? Investments with movements cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.

confirm.title: Confirm movement
confirm.description: The movement will change the account and investment balances.

cancelMovement.title: Cancel movement
cancelMovement.description: The movement stays in the history but no longer changes any balance.

movements.title: Investment history
movements.description: Contributions, withdrawals, and valuations, newest first.

hints.kindFixed: The type cannot be changed after creation.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.description: Delete {{name}}? Prefer deactivating categories that were already used. Deleting cannot be undone.

hints.spendingPerspective: Whether card spending counts by purchase date or by invoice month.
hints.defaultMonth: Month shown when the dashboard opens.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.subtitle: You do not have permission to access this page.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.subtitle: An unexpected error occurred. Reload the page to try again.

abilities.adminImmutable: The Administrator role's permissions are fixed and cannot be changed.
abilities.catalogRestricted: The complete permission catalog is unavailable with your access. Only the assigned permissions are shown; editing requires permission to read the catalog.

select.limited: Only roles from your account and the user being edited are available. Permission to read roles is required to see the complete list.

changeRequest.title: Approval required
changeRequest.offer: Send these changes to {{name}} as a change request? They apply only after approval and replace any pending request.
changeRequest.sent: Change request sent. The changes apply once {{name}} approves them.

updated.title: Profile updated
updated.description: Every session ended, including this one. Sign in again.
updated.confirmNewEmail: Before signing in, confirm your new email address with the link we sent to it.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password ends every session, including this one.

changeRequests.title: Change requests
changeRequests.description: Another administrator asked to change your profile. Review each change and approve or reject it.

approve.title: Approve this change request?
approve.description: The changes apply now and every session ends, including this one. You will need to sign in again.

reject.title: Reject this change request?
reject.description: Your profile stays as it is.

forgotPassword.title: Recover password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a password reset link.
forgotPassword.sentSubtitle: If an account exists for that email, you will receive a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.successSubtitle: Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.missingTokenSubtitle: The password reset link is incomplete.

resendConfirmation.title: Resend confirmation
resendConfirmation.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a new confirmation link.
resendConfirmation.sentSubtitle: If an unconfirmed account exists for that email, you will receive a new confirmation link.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm email
confirmEmail.subtitle: Confirm your email address to activate your account.
confirmEmail.missingTokenSubtitle: The email confirmation link is incomplete.

validation.strongPassword: Use at least {{min}} characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
validation.money: Enter a valid amount with up to two decimal places.
validation.positiveMoney: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.nonNegativeMoney: Enter an amount of zero or more.

apiErrors.network: Could not connect to the server.
apiErrors.timeout: The server took too long to respond.

pwa.offline: You are offline. Pages that need the server will not load until the connection returns.

update.title: New version available
update.description: Reload to use the latest version of the application.
